name: Loose fountain coping stone
description: A piece of the fountain's stone coping, approximately 20cm long, found near Owen's body. The east rim of the fountain has a gap where it was broken off. There is a smear of blood on one flat face.

name: Bundle of blackmail letters
description: A bundle of seven letters from Owen Price to Ben's father, Ted Carter, spanning twelve years. Each demands cash payments in exchange for silence about a fire that destroyed the old village hall in 2011. Owen's handwriting, Owen's address.

name: Ben's mobile phone
description: Ben's phone. The messages app shows a thread with Priya: at 22:00 Ben sent 'Sorry, can't make it tonight. Found something. Tell you later.' No further messages sent that evening.

name: Owen's pub receipt
description: A till receipt in Owen's jacket: three pints at The Mallet & Crown, timestamped 22:48. He left the pub shortly before closing.

name: Bootprint in the flower bed
description: A bootprint in the moist flower bed beside the fountain — left sole, size 9, with a distinctive V-shaped tread gap consistent with a work boot repair. Ben has his boots resoled each spring at the cobbler on Marsh Lane.

name: Newspaper clipping — village hall fire
description: A yellowed newspaper clipping in the blackmail bundle: '2011 Village Hall Fire — Cause Unknown'. A handwritten note in the margin, in Ted Carter's hand: 'Owen knows. He was there. He's making us pay.'

name: Mud on Ben's jacket cuff
description: Ben's work jacket, found in his flat: the right cuff is smeared with the same grey-brown mud as the flower bed by the fountain. It is still damp the next morning.
